Welcome to this comprehensive, step-by-step tutorial on building an end-to-end Data Engineering project entirely within the Databricks Free Edition!
In this video, we will design and build a robust, metadata-driven framework from scratch. Whether you are looking to understand the core architecture of a data pipeline or want hands-on experience with the latest Databricks features, this tutorial covers it all—from data ingestion and transformation to orchestration, governance, and BI consumption.
